gamerule.ocwo.fluid_displacement_limit.d: Maximum distance for fluids to find the way out when block placed in (0 = no displacement)
gamerule.ocwo.water_hot_fluid_evaporatio: Water evaporation upon contact with lava
Number of layers that will evaporate (0 = no evaporation)
gamerule.ocwo.farmland_water_intake.desc: Farmland consumes water, farmland also need to be connected with dirt-like block with water (0 = no consumption, -1 = vanilla behavior)
gamerule.ocwo.bucket_area_pickup.descrip: true (AREA): a bucket used on a block that is not full also takes water from the connected blocks around it on the same layer (up to 16 blocks, 4 blocks away), until full. false (COLUMN): only the targeted block and the block below it (PhysEx behaviour)
gamerule.ocwo.pressure_search_limit.desc: Max number of columns of water explored to find the highest surface and the lowest free point of a body of water (hydraulic pressure: tunnels fill completely, connected vessels reach the same level, fountains). 0 = pressure disabled
